context: Q-A from the fleet-night validate report (~/Buildo-scratch/fleet-night-2210/VALIDATE-REPORT-2.md:121-133): on an empty cursor compute_coa_cost_estimates leaves out its 17 declared emits and emits tier_none_count and archetype_coverage_pct as null (undefined+undefined is NaN; scripts/lib/compute/compute-coa-cost-estimates.js:265-290, finalizeMatched spreads m with no zero defaults; scripts/lib/step/index.js sums from {}). Precedent: zeroMatched in scripts/lib/compute/classify-coa-trades.js:59-75 (legacy pin L16). The report said the general rule 'Evening Rulings SWAP-1' was never recorded; it was recorded as R-JG (2026-10-22-page-eve#EVE.SWAP-1, 124a), which covers every counter a declared check reports. Q-A extends it to every declared emit and amends R-DE (iv); recorded as a dated note on R-JG plus a 124a section B-AM bullet (R-DE sits in moved block section B16). The cost-compute fix itself (red-first, own lane; it moves source_fingerprint, so the cost captures need a retake) is not part of this record.

decisions.subject: Must every declared emit be present on every run, an empty cursor included?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, as an amendment to R-DE (iv) (124a): every declared emit is present on every run; an empty cursor reads 0, never absent or N/A. Fix in compute_coa_cost_estimates red-first in its own lane, as trades did (zeroMatched); the fix moves source_fingerprint, so the cost captures need a retake. Five words: standardized (one rule, same as trades); observable (the shape no longer depends on the cursor); accurate (no NaN-nulls); scalable (every materializer); understandable (one sentence). No scope creep.
